Product Features

  • LED Headboard with sockets & USB connections: One of the most practical features is the built-in socket at the head of the bed, where you can charge your mobile phone and tablet before going to bed. Each socket has two EU standard charging outlets and two USB connections.
  • RGBW LED App-Control: Unlike ordinary LEDs, this bed is equipped with LEDs that can receive a broader spectrum of signals, with a light strip that changes its color, and with a music mode that enriches the sleeping experience. You can comfortably control different LED light modes via the mobile app. Please note that no music can be played.
  • Storage design: The shelf can be used to store mobile phones or tablets. With the support of the gas pressure spring, the space under the bed can be used to store large items.
  • Strong Construction: The main frame is made of iron and ensures the stability of the bed with a capacity of 400 lbs. The slats are made of elastic solid wood slats and provide a comfortable support for sleeping.
  • Detailed information: To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame is shipped in 2 cartons and these can arrive on different days. If both packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service. When moving the bed, please lift it instead of dragging it on the floor. Before returning the product, please contact the seller first. Thank you for your understanding.
